title: Divisible and Non-divisible Sums Difference
description:
You are given two integers n and m.

Consider numbers from 1 to n.

Definitions
num1 = sum of numbers not divisible by m
num2 = sum of numbers divisible by m
Task

Return:

num1 - num2
Examples

Example 1

n = 10, m = 3
→ 19

Example 2

n = 5, m = 6
→ 15

Example 3

n = 5, m = 1
→ -15
Constraints
1 ≤ n, m ≤ 1000
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
